implementation.source_admission: Emitter proposals are staged before the sole shared spatial build and resolved by its common admission/finalization passes. Accepted, rejected and capacity-miss counters remain observable.
implementation.stable_identity: Stable IDs are reserved monotonically for proposals. Rejection may leave the F8-09-permitted gaps, but outflow and later capacity recovery never reuse an ID.
implementation.removal: Destroy planes mark staged liquid particles and one fixed gather compacts them before the normal atomic endpoint swap.
implementation.phase_discovery: The final liquid/smoke solve sweep records fixed-capacity proposals and their full particle/thermal state without mutating public counts.
implementation.phase_admission: The next boundary generation-checks source and destination, aggregates destination capacity globally and either applies all pending transfers or none before the single spatial publication.
implementation.phase_failure: Destination-capacity or generation failure preserves source mass, source stable IDs and pending inputs. Destination replacement clears stale generation state and permits safe rediscovery.
implementation.fixed_schedule: GPU-resident live counts feed predict, query, solve, coupling, commit and export. Completion reads source/phase counters only after terminal queue completion; telemetry records zero intra-tick host readbacks.
implementation.adapter_parity: CPU, CUDA, Metal, D3D12 and Vulkan dispatch tables bind the common spatial admission and transfer-finalization primitives; no Android-local implementation exists.

public_cases: cold source spawn accepts a bounded particle set at the authored 35 C temperature
a full liquid rejects the next proposals with unchanged active count, stable IDs, dispatches and workgroups
destroy-plane outflow compacts to zero and a later source tick recovers capacity with non-reused stable IDs
a 150 C liquid against a 100 C boiling threshold is discovered on one solve and transfers to particle smoke at the next boundary
a full smoke destination rejects phase admission while preserving one liquid particle, its stable ID and one existing smoke particle
destination replacement invalidates stale generation state, then rediscovery and the following boundary complete the transfer with the original source ID
focused and broad mixed-family paths cover reset, replacement, topology mutation and sequential fixed ticks through the public native API
